text: The deep woods past Oakstead, further than anyone else in town bothers to go. Kai bothers.

speaker: Kai
text: Two more ridges than I told Mum I'd go. Three, if the redcaps are up over the far one.

speaker: Kai
text: ...they're always up over the far one. That's the whole point of the far one.
He knows this forest the way most people know a house. And there, in a hillside he's walked past a hundred times: the mouth of a cave. Plain. Ordinary. Never once explored.

speaker: Kai
text: Huh. How have I never gone in there?

speaker: Kai
text: ...that's not a reason to keep not going in there.
